item.title: Flood defence measures are being installed at a number of council homes in a part of Hammersmith.
item.description: It’s after residents living in Lorne Gardens saw their street flooded in January after a watermain burst at Holland Park Roundabout. Thousands of litres of water was pumped out downhill every minute and twenty-seven properties were affected. Hammersmith and Fulham Council has confirmed funding for the project and secured contributions from Thames Water and Peabody.

item.title: Surrey County Council is terminating two further critical support services at Leatherhead based Crossroads Care Surrey.
item.description: The charity says both the Emergency Care Provision and the End of Life support service have now been withdrawn. item.title: The former host of Never Mind the Buzzcocks has been banned from driving.
item.description: Comedian, Mark Lamarr, admitted doing 46mph in a 40mph zone in Twickenham last June. Willesden Magistrates' Court imposed three penalty points on him, fined him £236 and banned him from driving for six months. item.title: Britain's Jack Draper has withdrawn from next week's Monte Carlo Masters tennis as he continues to manage his recovery from an arm injury.
item.description: The world number 25 from Sutton has competed in three events in five weeks since making his return to competitive action. He'll keep training in London to build his fitness ahead of the clay court season.

item.title: New rules for household waste and recycling have come into force across England.
item.description: People across South West London and Surrey will now have to separate their rubbish into a maximum of four different bins. One for food and garden waste, one for paper and card, one for dry recyclables and once for general non-recyclable rubbish.

item.title: British sprinter Adam Gemili is looking forward to helping youngsters benefit from his experience.
item.description: The 32-year-old has announced his retirement from athletics. He’s won gold in the 4-by-100-metres at the London World Championships in 2017 and four European titles. Gemili tells us, he'll now be passing on his knowledge at Chelsea’s academy as a speed coach. https://audioboom.com/posts/8881213-adam-gemili

item.title: Surrey Police is warning residents about the rising theft of catalytic converters, which can be stolen in under a minute.
item.description: Hybrid vehicles are often targeted, but any car can be at risk for the precious metals inside, particularly on streets and in car parks. Police are advising parking in well-lit areas, using locks or forensic marking, and installing CCTV or motion-sensor lighting. item.title: Two teenage girls have been arrested after hundreds of youths descended on Clapham High Street last night.
item.description: Some shops were forced to close as youngsters “rampaged” through the area. Police say a dispersal order was put in place and officer patrols will continue today. The pair arrested were done so on suspicion of assaulting an emergency worker.

item.title: Chelsea have announced a pre-tax loss of just over £262 million in the last financial year.
item.description: The Londoners had posted a profit of over £128 million in the previous year's accounts. Revenue was up to just under £491-million, the second highest on record for Chelsea, which was helped by last summer's Club World Cup victory.
